title: HECM Line-of-Credit Draws: Servicing Policy
content:
**§1 Availability.** A line-of-credit draw on a Home Equity Conversion Mortgage (HECM) is available only on a payout plan that carries line-of-credit draws after closing; on any other plan the request is declined with the reason plan not eligible. A draw is booked only while the loan status is active.

**§2 Request on file.** A draw is booked only against a borrower draw request on file for that loan whose request type is a line-of-credit draw and whose request status is submitted. The request record itself is the authority; a caller's statement that a request was made does not stand in for it.

**§3 Maturity suspension.** Cedarline suspends every disbursement from the day a maturity case is opened on the loan, so a draw request is declined with the reason loan not active while the loan has a maturity case whose status is opened, awaiting HUD approval, due and payable, extension period or foreclosure referred.

**§4 Amount limits.** *Retired, no longer in force and superseded by the current basis:* the clause that the draw amount must be at least the plan's smallest draw, otherwise declined with reason below minimum draw, and may not exceed the loan's available line on the handling date, otherwise declined with reason insufficient available line, funds held in any set-aside never being part of the available line nor released through a draw.

**§5 First-year limit.** *Retired, no longer in force and superseded by the current basis:* the clause that during the first-year period the closing disbursement amount plus the first-year draws plus the requested draw may not exceed the loan's initial disbursement limit. In force: draws that would bring first-year disbursements above the initial disbursement limit are booked only on or after the first anniversary of the loan closing; a draw handled on the anniversary day itself may be booked, one handled the day before may not. *Retired, no longer in force and superseded by the current basis:* the sentence defining the first anniversary as the same day number in the month the first-year period's calendar months after the closing date, falling back to the last day of that month when that day does not exist. In force: a request that breaches the first-year limit before the anniversary is declined in full with the reason first year limit exceeded; Cedarline never partially funds a draw request.

**§6 Channel and method.** A phone request above the plan's phone figure is declined with the reason channel limit exceeded; servicing-portal and signed written requests carry no channel cap. The disbursement method must be one of the plan's draw disbursement methods; a wire is used only for a draw of at least the plan's wire figure, and a smaller draw requested by wire is disbursed by ACH instead.

**§7 Booking.** Each request is disbursed at most once. A disbursed draw books one line-of-credit draw against the available line and, on the same effective date, one advance posting of the draw type for the same amount against the loan balance; the effective date is the handling date, which must fall within the plan's draw processing business days of the request date. On success the request status becomes processed with no decline reason; a declined request gets request status declined and its decline reason, and nothing is posted.

**§8 Other advance postings.** Advance postings of every other type are booked only as the consequence of the originating set-aside disbursement, repayment-plan advance or occupancy inspection, for the same amount and date, referencing that originating record.
